name: Maneuvering Dodge
body:
Maneuvering Dodge (Ex)
Source Inner Sea Intrigue pg. 32
Whenever a foe of the rogue’s size or larger misses the rogue with a melee attack, the rogue gains a +2 bonus on any Acrobatics, Climb, Fly, and Swim checks she attempts for 1 round. At 8th level, this bonus increases to +4.
